platformCard.step1Desc: Complete the form with your name as on ID card, Business ID, and agree to Terms & Conditions.
platformCard.step2Desc: Tentaklik Compliance Team will review the eligibility of your ad account request.
platformCard.step3Desc: Once approved, we will process the linking and creation of your Whitelisted ad account.
platformCard.step4Desc: Top up your account balance first via the dashboard so ads can run.
platformCard.step5Desc: Account is ready to use! You can directly run ad campaigns without obstacles.
